s.zh: 倒下了，但巨魔血肉仍在重生：约1天后会复活。火焰、火化或腐烂会打断它。
s.en: has fallen, but the troll flesh is still regenerating: revives in about 1 day. Fire, cremation or rot will interrupt it.

s.zh: 仍在再生：约1天后会重新站起来。烧掉或火化尸体可以阻止。
s.en: is still regenerating: will stand up again in about 1 day. Burning or cremating the corpse can stop it.

s.zh: 的尸体被火焰灼烧，巨魔再生彻底中断。
s.en: 's corpse was scorched by fire; troll regeneration is completely cut off.

s.zh: 小时后复活（烧掉或火化尸体可阻止）
s.en: hours until revival (burning or cremating the corpse can stop it)

s.zh: 的血肉重新长合，从死亡中站了起来。
s.en: 's flesh knitted back together, and they rose from death.
